description: This file defines a Java interface named EntityPopulator, which declares methods for populating entity objects from source data. It is part of the core utilities of the Shopizer project, used for converting or transferring data between different representations or layers.

classes.name: EntityPopulator
classes.description: A generic interface for populating target entities from source data, possibly involving a MerchantStore context, with methods that may throw ConversionException.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Populates the target entity from the source object and merchant store context, potentially throwing a ConversionException.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Populates the target entity from the source object alone, potentially throwing a ConversionException.
